fields.desc: You have learned to harness your inner vitality to replenish your ki. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Boundless Reserves
fields.prerequisite: *Wisdom 13 or higher and the Ki class feature*

fields.desc: You are difficult to wear down and kill. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Diehard

fields.desc: You have studied the secret language of Floriography. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Floriographer
fields.prerequisite: *Proficiency in one of the following skills: Arcana, History, or Nature*

fields.desc: You are familiar with the ways of the forest. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Forest Denizen

fields.desc: After spending some time in forests, you have attuned yourself to the ways of the woods and the creatures in it.
fields.name: Friend of the Forest

fields.desc: Your experience fighting giants, such as ogres, trolls, and frost giants, has taught you how to avoid their deadliest blows and how to wield mighty weapons to better combat them. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Giant Foe

fields.desc: You have learned to maximize the strategic impact of your misty step. You appear in a flash and, while your foe is disoriented, attack with deadly precision. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Harrier
fields.prerequisite: *The Shadow Traveler shadow fey trait or the ability to cast the* misty step *spell*

fields.desc: Your internal discipline gives you access to a small pool of ki points. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Inner Resilience

fields.desc: Wolves are never seen to be far from your side and consider you to be a packmate. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Part of the Pack

fields.desc: You are from an area with a cold climate and have learned to adapt your magic to reflect your heritage. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Rimecaster
fields.prerequisite: *A race or background from a cold climate and the ability to cast at least one spell*

fields.desc: When your magical reserves are low, you can call on your lifeforce to fuel your magic.
fields.name: Sorcerous Vigor
fields.prerequisite: *Charisma 13 or higher and the Sorcery Points class feature*

fields.desc: You are an expert at hunting prey. You are never more at home than when on a hunt, and your quarry rarely escapes you. You gain the following benefits:
fields.name: Stalker

fields.desc: You have mastered the use of ranged weapons to cripple your target from a distance.
fields.name: Stunning Sniper
